scope: main clinic11 source/development mechanisms only; not a CAR3 training amendment

candidate_extensions.name: reciprocal direction-and-map mechanism panel
candidate_extensions.category: new controlled mechanism extension of existing H2; not a new primary endpoint
candidate_extensions.question: Does the learned low-dimensional direction restriction explain benefit beyond a favourable synthetic corruption family or independently tuned learned-additive adaptation?
reuse: same frozen f0 and source-only Rref
actual independently learned P and B8 dictionaries
original B20 support UIDs and fixed future query UIDs
same method-specific frozen configurations and original heads
directions: unit-Frobenius orthogonal-to-anchor-span with matched symmetric/skew energy when feasible
candidate_extensions.unperturbed_cell: one shared zero-dose cell; do not duplicate by family/anchor
candidate_extensions.radius_rule: Exactly one common perturbation radius min(rho_P,rho_B8), obtained from the unique already-frozen native P and B8 configurations. Apply the two listed dose fractions only; never traverse the registered rho grid again. Original method-specific fit radii stay unchanged; all methods receive the identical corruption for a cell.
candidate_extensions.reference_frame: same explicit whitened effective 10D coordinates and Q/Rref; inject after original preprocessing and before joint trial RMS
candidate_extensions.matched_energy_rule: equal generator norm and symmetric/skew fractions within each pair; report visible conditioning and actual signal changes. If complementary subspace cannot match, retain unavailable cell and reason; do not silently use an easier direction.
candidate_extensions.cross_family_rule: coefficient dose is not equal signal or singular-value distortion across exp/additive; report both and refrain from claiming matched physical perturbation
candidate_extensions.fairness: All methods receive exactly the same corrupted support/query and acquired B20 ledger for a cell. Apply teacher/PCT contracts consistently if extra PCT arms are later registered. A repeated synthetic view is neither a new participant nor another independent clinical replicate.
candidate_extensions.analysis: aggregate sessions/directions/cells and five fixed pipelines within participant before paired participant summaries; show anchor x family x in/out x dose rather than one favourable cell

pilot_plan.metadata_only_choice: first eligible validation IDs and first eligible physical session in the frozen metadata order, first original frozen pipeline seed; no internal holdout or external data
pilot_plan.engineering_advance_rule: only provenance, input replay, finite outputs, budget accounting and measured resource bounds; never an accuracy advantage criterion

important_limits: An exact inverse is an input-replay control, not an accuracy upper bound or feasible deployment oracle.
Orthogonal generator direction does not imply functionally uncorrectable EEG: data stabilizers, normalization and head adaptation can yield equivalent predictions.
Generating shifts in a learned span is a capacity test; it does not prove the span matches natural cross-session shifts or real electrode movement.
Synthetic drift may distort labels physiologically; retained labels are a simulation assumption, not a newly validated clinical task.
falsifiers: P wins only on P-anchor/exp cells and the advantage reverses on B8-anchor/additive cells.
B8 matches P on native data; then no empirical matrix-exp advantage may be claimed.
Random directions or head-only adaptation explain the same recovery.

paired_map_replay_diagnostic.scope: development-only counterfactual forward diagnostic; not a replacement for independently optimized B8
anchors: actual P-fitted M and target head
actual B8-fitted M and target head
paired_map_replay_diagnostic.procedure: Within each anchor keep M, target head, source network, input, normalization and reference identical; replay exp(M) and I+M, retaining both directions of the comparison.
paired_map_replay_diagnostic.extra_inference_cost: measure actual forward passes/time; not free
paired_map_replay_diagnostic.interpretation: fixed-M local mapping effect, not a causal guarantee or fair end-to-end ranking between separately trained algorithms

candidate_extensions.name: support-only observable shift proxy and benefit boundary
candidate_extensions.category: exploratory new moderator; not complete correctability, a causal mechanism or an admission rule
candidate_extensions.question: Is a pre-outcome, support-only locally covariance-visible direction score associated with later participant-level P-minus-Bstar benefit?
candidate_extensions.inputs: same pre-RMS support prefix only, fixed source/development-only reference and frozen learned dictionary; no query covariance or labels; no extra labels
candidate_extensions.mathematical_requirement: Use an explicitly derived observable push-forward (G C+C G^T), including trace/shape normalization derivative where used, and project the same-frame observed covariance contrast onto its SVD image. Do not project log covariance directly onto the full generator span. An averaged post-trial-RMS covariance is not generally T C T^T.
candidate_extensions.mandatory_visibility_counterexample: At C=I, every skew generator has G C+C G^T=0; rotations may be invisible. A zero image or unmeasurable contrast is undefined/not identifiable, never a fabricated zero score.
controls: observable image rank and matched random-dictionary image dimension
source reference and covariance-estimator descriptors fixed before evaluation
gauge-rotation invariance of any subspace score
candidate_extensions.analysis: continuous participant-level secondary summaries with uncertainty and no query-derived thresholds; development-only implementation and validation first. No new gate, method switch, exclusion or promise to predict individual patient benefit.
candidate_extensions.implementation_status: requires a validated observation map and estimators; not implemented by this plan
falsifiers: association absent or unstable after participant aggregation
only covariance magnitude or observable dimension explains association
skew/normalization counterexamples invalidate the chosen proxy

candidate_extensions.name: robust benefit summaries from already planned predictions
candidate_extensions.category: analysis enhancement; not a new algorithm or claim that budget curves/negative flips are new
proposals: paired P-minus-Bstar integral over the originally fixed 4/8/12/16/20-label curve, if and only if the registered budget entry produces real gated predictions
leave-one-participant-out influence on cohort mean differences and intervals
participant-level simultaneous positive contrast versus B8, B9 and Bstar with ties/unknowns retained
candidate_extensions.budget_qualification: same future query beyond acquired B20; hiding labels does not reduce acquired trials or waiting time. Current formal episode/evaluator remains B20; smaller-budget mathematical kernels do not establish an accepted budget-curve transaction.
candidate_extensions.statistical_qualification: no p-values until the complete analysis family and actual cohorts are frozen; no pooling trials/sessions/seeds as people; no changing H1 or deleting influential participants
candidate_extensions.training_cost: no extra fits for influence and simultaneous-contrast summaries if original predictions exist; budget-curve fits and counterfactual predictions have their own actual cost
falsifiers: mean advantage depends on one participant
gain exists only against random or weak methods
apparent low-label efficiency disappears under actual acquired-trial accounting

nearest_neighbour_policy.required: Reconcile recent spatial low-rank and matrix-exp/congruence adaptation literature before any first/unique claim.
nearest_neighbour_policy.mapping: B6/B10/B8 are family controls; do not call them faithful reproductions of a new paper without verified mathematical/code mapping.
nearest_neighbour_policy.transductive_limit: A nearest method using whole-target unlabeled statistics cannot access this protocol sealed query; a support-only port must be named as a port, never an exact original replication.
nearest_neighbour_policy.body_code_discrepancy: If a paper abstract asserts a low-rank adapter but body/code lacks the parameterization, record the implementation gap instead of inventing it.

phase_gates: finish actual native source/development W1-W6 artifacts before any model-dependent diagnostic
seal extension choice, formulas, dose/method cells, provenance and resource ledger before its first result
retain failed/unavailable cells and negative outcomes
no new scientific run until later user manual GPU boot and valid run-specific positive budget
no external prediction until W7 algorithm seal and native qualification plus actual cohort/family seal
prepare all counterfactual predictions before any external label reveal if later formally included; W9 summaries cannot silently rerun a changed model
prohibited_novelty_claims: first matrix exponential or invertible spatial EEG adaptation
first low-rank spatial adapter or first low-label prefix calibration
individual G components as identifiable causal neurophysiology
guaranteed accuracy improvement or patient safety from invertibility/bounds
new independent people from source cache derivatives or synthetic views
